about: Single source of the plan. Published with every main deploy as /Life-Care/plan.json and loaded into Settings → 📝 Tracker. Update it whenever an item starts or finishes (Coder and Architect). tokenPct = estimated % of a weekly allowance. Statuses: New, Planned, In progress, Blocked, Done, Won't do.
